finding.requirement: Master prompt §20 asks the ER solver to report cases no amount of ER can fix.

evidence.detail: Requires feasibility, scenario, optional verified safety margin, and reporting cases no amount of ER can fix.

Result type includes er-independent-failure, but solveEnergyRecharge only returns feasible-on-grid, infeasible-within-bounds, or blocked. An empty finite grid is explicitly not proof that higher ER cannot work.
The no-source example is asserted as infeasible-within-bounds and the test requires only the bounded no-particle explanation; it does not establish or report ER-independent failure.
UI already has a distinct user-facing label for er-independent-failure, but no current solver branch can produce it.
Status records energy analysis as delivered, while arbitrary team closure remains incomplete; this finding is specifically the solver's missing proof-backed classification.

finding.nextStep: Implement the existing er-independent-failure result only for failures whose cause is demonstrably invariant to ER, using actual candidate/run failure evidence. Keep finite-grid misses as infeasible-within-bounds; zero observed particles or no feasible candidate alone must never prove unbounded impossibility. Include the invariant cause and scenario in the returned explanation.
finding.acceptance: A proven energy-independent failure receives the distinct status and a source-backed reason; a bounded search with no feasible candidate but no such proof remains infeasible-within-bounds and explicitly disclaims extrapolation. Preserve the existing exhaustive grid, non-monotonic handling, candidate receipts, and worker UI.

scope: Observed fixed command cost exceeds fixed capacity using shared execution precision.
All-energy-success strict timeline remains illegal without dynamic cooldown or Stellar Swirl feedback.
notProved: General deterministic or stochastic steady state.
